local.title: What a coating is up against in West Bloomfield.
local.intro: The county salts the main roads first and reaches the subdivisions last. The township protects its woodlands, so the trees stay put. Some streets are gravel. Each one leaves something different on the paint, and a coating changes how all of it comes off.

points.title: Brine first, slush after
points.body: The Road Commission for Oakland County often sprays main roads with liquid brine ahead of a storm, and Orchard Lake Road and Middlebelt are cleared before the subdivisions. So the car collects salt on the way home and then parks in slush. On a coated panel that salt does not get to sit against bare clear coat, and a rinse and a gentle hand wash takes it off.

points.title: Protected trees overhead
points.body: Trees inside the township's designated woodlands cannot be cut without going through the township first, and the 162 acre West Bloomfield Woods Nature Preserve has mature oak and hickory. For a car parked under branches, that means sap and bird droppings. On a coated car they wipe off before they etch the paint.

points.title: Gravel dust that rinses off
points.body: Some residents here live on gravel roads. The county sands them in winter and, where a road is signed up for dust control, sprays calcium chloride brine in summer. On bare paint that film gets rubbed in at the next wash. On a coating it comes off with a rinse and a gentle hand wash.

points.title: Highway miles, and one honest limit
points.body: Northwestern Highway ends at Orchard Lake Road and M-5 passes just west of the township line. Both lead to I-696, and highway miles are where a front end collects bugs and stone chips. Bugs wipe off a coated bumper before they etch. Rock chips are a different matter: a coating is not armor and will not stop them.

logistics.title: The coating goes on at our shop. Here is how the distance works.
body: We coat indoors at 33115 Louise Ave in Clinton Township, because the work needs steady light, steady temperature and time to cure before the vehicle goes back outside. That is about 25 miles from central West Bloomfield, roughly 45 minutes without traffic.

From West Bloomfield, count on the vehicle being with us for at least a full day, longer when the paint needs more correction. We give you an exact window when we quote, so you can plan one trip to drop off and one to collect. Uber is covered for both on coating jobs.

Our pick-up and drop-off valet is the option most coating customers choose when they cannot spare the day. West Bloomfield sits at the edge of our range, so tell us where you are and we will confirm whether we can collect from your address.

faq.q: Can you apply a ceramic coating at my home in West Bloomfield?
faq.a: No. A coating has to go on indoors, away from wind, dust and direct sun, and it cures in the shop before you get the vehicle back. Detailing is the only work we take on the road, and this far out we confirm even that by address. For a coating the choice is the drive, the covered Uber, or asking us whether valet pickup reaches your address.

faq.q: How many trips to the shop does a coating take?
faq.a: Plan on two for the coating itself: one to drop off and one to collect, with Uber covered for both. The vehicle stays at least a full day, longer when the paint needs more correction, and you get an exact window with your quote. Every package also includes a free follow-up wash with an inspection, which we schedule with you afterward.

faq.q: My car is parked under trees. Will a coating stop sap from damaging the paint?
faq.a: It makes sap, bird droppings and bugs wipe off before they etch, which is the real problem on bare clear coat. It does not make the car maintenance free. You still wash it, and the sooner that stuff comes off the better. Skip brush-style automatic washes, which put swirls in any finish. Touchless is fine. The aftercare guide you leave with covers the rest.

faq.q: How much does ceramic coating cost?
faq.a: It is quoted per vehicle. Size, paint condition and how much correction the paint needs before coating all change the work, so we do not publish a price list. Tell us what you drive and we will give you a real number. Financing is available through Affirm and Klarna over 3 to 24 months, as low as 0% interest.
